events.title: STEP THEATER Is Coming to Steam Next Fest!
events.summary: STEP THEATER Is Coming to Steam Next Fest!Thank you for your continued support of STEP THEATER! We're excited to announce that STEP THEATER will be participating in Steam Next Fest this October! Steam Next Fest is an event where players can discover upcoming games and try out free demos. STEP THEATER is a rhythm game where you progress through stages to the beat of the music. Our free demo is already available, offering approximately 20 minutes of gameplay. events.title: STEP THEATER Coming to Nintendo Switch 2 and Nintendo Switch!
events.summary: We, NB Games, are honored to share an update here on the Steam Community about the platforms STEP THEATER will be available on.The game is scheduled to launch on Nintendo Switch 2, Nintendo Switch, and Steam on December 3, 2026.You can wishlist STEP THEATER on Steam now.Add it to your wishlist and stay tuned for launch!We’ll continue to share the latest STEP THEATER news and updates here on the Steam Community.

events.title: STEP THEATER Launches December 3, 2026!
events.summary: We’re excited to announce that STEP THEATER will launch on December 3, 2026!STEP THEATER is a music and rhythm game in which players step to the beat and advance the stories unfolding on screen.With every step, the scene, music, and required actions change.
